$\frac{120 - x}{120} \times \frac{x}{119} = \frac{18}{85}$

$120x - x^2 = 3024$
$x^2 - 120x + 3024 = 0$
$(x - 84)(x - 36) = 0$
$x = 84$ of $x = 36$
